title: Executive – IT Support
description:
**About Medhavi Foundation**

Medhavi Foundation is an education and skill development organization, founded in 2012 by IIT alumni, with a vision to bridge the gap between the demand and supply of skilled manpower across various vocational streams. Medhavi is driven by a commitment to develop India’s vocational talent

pool through a unique combination of best-in-class learning technologies, expert trainers across disciplines, and a nationwide network of high-quality model skill training centres. Medhavi Foundation is the sponsoring body of Medhavi Skills University, Sikkim. It is registered as a not-for-profit organization under Section 25 of the Indian Companies Act, 1956. To achieve its mission, Medhavi Foundation has partnered with the National Skill Development Corporation,multiple corporates, and various State Skill Missions. By 2025, it has successfully skilled, trained, and created employment opportunities for over 5 lakh youth across India.

For more information, visit https://medhavifoundation.org

**Role Overview:**

The IT Support Executive will manage daily IT operations, maintain office infrastructure and assets,and provide timely technical support across Kolkata offices. The role includes supporting laptops,managing employee IT requirements, and ensuring reliable network, communication, and conference facilities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and maintain IT infrastructure across the assigned offices.
* Configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, including asset assignment and allocation records.
* Maintain an accurate IT asset inventory and track asset movement, condition, maintenance,and returns.
* Install, configure, and update approved software; resolve laptop, desktop, printer, peripheral,and mobile device issues.
* Complete IT onboarding and offboarding activities, including device allocation, account coordination, access removal, and asset recovery.
* Back up departing employees’ official data to the NAS according to organizational requirements and access policies.
* Manage and maintain local servers, NAS storage, and routine backup operations.
* Configure and apply Google Workspace security and device management policies to laptops and mobile devices.
* Support organizational email, user accounts, access permissions, and collaboration tools.
* Manage firewalls, configure network switches, and troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity.
* Maintain and troubleshoot CCTV surveillance, telephone, and biometric attendance systems.
* Set up conference rooms and provide day-to-day video conferencing and meeting support.
* Monitor UPS health and coordinate maintenance to support power availability.
* Resolve IT support tickets across Kolkata offices and record issues received through calls or direct requests.
* Provide priority IT assistance to the Director, including device, connectivity, software, and meeting support.
* Coordinate with vendors for IT procurement, repairs, warranties, servicing, and technical issue resolution.
* Maintain technical documentation, asset records, configuration details, and support reports.
* Follow organizational IT security policies and promptly report security incidents or unauthorized access.
* Provide all other IT-related support and carry out additional IT responsibilities as assigned, based on organizational and operational requirements.

**Qualifications & Skills Required:**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience in IT support, laptop troubleshooting, software installation, and asset management.
* Working knowledge of Google Workspace administration, endpoint policies, local servers,and NAS backups.
* Understanding of networking, firewalls, switches, CCTV, telephone systems, UPS, and video conferencing equipment.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and task prioritization skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and support users across multipleoffices.

**What We Offer**

* Being a key player in something potentially massive and world-changing
* Competitive salary and incentive structure, best in the industry.
* Opportunities for professional development and growth.
* A supportive and collaborative work environment.
* The chance to make a meaningful impact on the careers and lives of working professionals.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at careers@msu.edu.in at earliest possible.

Medhavi Skills University is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: System Administrator (Intern/Full Time)
description:
**Job Description:** We are seeking a dedicated and proactive System Administrator to provide in-house IT support and ensure the smooth operation of our IT infrastructure. The candidate will diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve software and hardware-related issues, manage networks, maintain systems, and support internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**System Maintenance and Infrastructure Support**

-Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues for laptops, desktops, and related systems

- Assemble, upgrade, and maintain computer systems as required

- Install, configure, and maintain operating systems (Windows/Linux)

- Ensure smooth functioning of day-to-day infrastructure including servers, local systems, internet, and internal access systems

- Monitor system and infrastructure health and take proactive actions to prevent failures

- Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, peripheral, and access-related issues (including printers, scanners, VPN, and internal tools)

- Proactively debug and fix infrastructure-related issues to minimize downtime

- Handle data and file transfers across systems and servers as part of infrastructure operations

**Network Management**

- Set up and maintain LAN and WAN infrastructure

- Troubleshoot and resolve network connectivity issues

- Ensure system and network security through monitoring and firewall maintenance

- Manage and maintain VPN and access control systems; debug connectivity and authentication issues

- Coordinate with external vendors (internet providers, hosting, domain/ email services) to resolve issues

**Server Administration and Engineering Support**

- Install, configure, and maintain servers (web servers, file-sharing systems, and related services)

- Troubleshoot server-related issues and ensure uptime

- Set up and manage NFS servers and cross-mounting across systems

- Configure and support job scheduling systems (e.g., Slurm controllers and clients)

- Manage, maintain, and improve existing Git infrastructure (including master and mirror setups)

- Implement and support user management systems (NIS/LDAP) on Linux environments (preferably CentOS 7 or similar)

- Configure and support distributed setups (e.g., primary/mirror servers and multiple clients)

- Install, configure, and test tools required for engineering teams and internal workflows

- Ensure reliability and proper functioning of development and infrastructure-related tools

**Automation and Process Improvement**

- Use AI tools to automate processes across Engineering, HR, and Marketing functions

- Develop and maintain scripts using languages such as Python, Perl, Shell, or Make to improve efficiency

**Documentation and Administrative Support**

- Maintain documentation of system configurations, processes, and changes

- Handle basic administrative and tracking tasks (including Excel-based work)

**Required Skills:**

- Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and infrastructure

- Familiarity with Linux and/or Windows environments

- Basic to intermediate knowledge of networking (LAN/WAN, IP, DNS)

- Familiarity with scripting/automation (Python, Perl, Shell, Make, or similar)

- Understanding of system security and firewall basics

- Basic familiarity with web servers and hosting environments is a plus

-Good communication skills for coordinating with internal teams and external vendors

**Key Traits:**

-Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and proactiveness in identifying and resolving issues without constant supervision

- High tenacity in problem-solving

- Ability to debug and resolve critical issues (time-sensitive or complex)

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks

Please fill the application form at **https://semifront.com/apply-form/**

* B Tech/ BE in IT/ CSE/ any relevant stream (Preferred)

title: IT Helpdesk Engineer - M365 Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** M365 Client Success Specialist  
**Location:** Kolkata, India  
**Company:** Salescom Services  
**Shift Timings:** UK Shift  
**Working Days:** Mon to Friday (Half Day on 1 Saturday in a month)  
**Employment Type:** Full Time On-Site  
**Industry:** Telecoms, IT and Security

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **System Administration and Support:** End-to-end administration of Microsoft 365 tenants, including user account management, licensing, and security compliance.
* **Platform Configuration:** Support and configuration of Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Exchange Online.
* **Workflow Automation:** Utilize Power Platform (Power Automate, Power BI, Power Apps) to create efficient business solutions.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:** Perform audit log evaluations, monitor system usage, and generate reports on platform performance.
* **User Training & Documentation:** Create documentation, provide troubleshooting support, and train employees on M365 collaboration tools.
* **Security & Compliance:** Implement and monitor data security policies to prevent data loss.
* **Client Onboarding & Adoption Management:** Plan and execute structured onboarding programs for new Microsoft 365 customers, ensuring smooth transition, user adoption, and early value realization.
* **Customer Success & Relationship Management:** Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, conducting regular check-ins, success reviews, and health assessments to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
* **Incident & Escalation Management:** Manage service incidents, coordinate with Microsoft support and internal resolver teams, track SLAs, and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.
* **Change Management & Feature Rollout:** Plan and support Microsoft 365 feature updates, roadmap changes, and tenant-wide deployments, ensuring minimal business disruption and effective communication to stakeholders.
* **License Optimization & Cost Management:** Analyze license usage and recommend optimization strategies to reduce cost, improve utilization, and align licensing with business needs.
* **Governance & Best Practices Implementation:** Design and enforce governance models for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive including naming conventions, lifecycle management, access controls, and information architecture.
* **Integration & Ecosystem Support:** Support integration of Microsoft 365 with third‑party tools, identity systems (Azure AD / Entra ID), and line‑of‑business applications used by customers.
* **Knowledge Management & Continuous Improvement:** Maintain internal knowledge bases, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and lessons learned to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.

**Pre-Requisites:**

* 3 plus years of hands‑on experience in Microsoft 365 administration and support.
* Deep knowledge of M365 services (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange).
* Experience in a client‑facing or customer-success role, preferably in IT services, MSPs or SaaS environments.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, and data analysis.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, often in second-line support roles.
* Strong interpersonal skills for stakeholder management and training.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant post‑graduate certifications or diplomas in Cloud Computing or Microsoft technologies are an advantage

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary, periodic reviews and performance-based bonuses.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage for self and chosen family dependents.
* Professional development opportunities, including training and company funded certifications.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity and creativity.
* Opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the growth of the company.

**How to Apply:**  
Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and cover letter to **puja@v4one.co.uk** in confidence. Please label “M365 Client Success Specialist Application” in the email subject line. All candidates will be treated equally, and we will base decisions on appointments on the merits of the candidates. We welcome applications from all candidates, regardless of any protected characteristic and are an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
